title: gates: the walks run apart from the line, and fmt checks only the packages a change touches
goal: On a cloud VM's 4 cores Susi's gates need about 53 CPU-seconds, 13 to 16 s warm; the CEO, 2026-11-26: trim the suites so cloud gates fit 4 cores, with the end-to-end walks apart. A repository whose .config/nextest.toml names a profile gates-walks gets it run after the line, beside product-target Clippy: it must pass, and its wall is printed apart. cargo fmt --check runs only on the packages whose files a change touches since its merge base with origin/main (all of them when a manifest-free root file like rustfmt.toml or rust-toolchain changed, or no base is known): rustfmt formats file by file, and main is formatted.
